tests.name: test_real_inventory_has_95_business_operations_and_four_admin_auth
tests.assertion: 99 个操作、95 项业务、4 个 admin 认证排除，字段和 key 唯一性完整。

tests.name: test_high_risk_domains_are_present_and_classified_high
tests.assertion: 七个高风险域均存在且风险级别为 high。

tests.name: test_drift_detection_reports_renamed_and_missing_operations
tests.assertion: operationId 改名和操作缺失都被漂移检查报告。

tests.name: test_missing_cell_fails
tests.assertion: 缺少任一场景格校验失败。

tests.name: test_high_risk_not_applicable_fails
tests.assertion: 高风险接口不得将四类场景标为不适用。

tests.name: test_normal_not_applicable_fails
tests.assertion: 正常与异常场景不得标为不适用。

tests.name: test_stale_test_node_fails
tests.assertion: 引用不存在的测试节点校验失败。

tests.name: test_pending_human_review_fails
tests.assertion: 待人工复核的不适用格校验失败。

tests.name: test_real_sample_report_and_read_only_workflow_pass
tests.assertion: 真实样例报告和只读 CI 工作流通过交接校验。

tests.name: test_report_without_limitations_or_identity_fails
tests.assertion: 缺少限制或内容哈希的报告校验失败。

tests.name: test_workflow_with_write_permission_or_comment_fails
tests.assertion: CI 写权限或 PR 评论被拒绝。

tests.name: test_upload_must_fail_when_report_missing
tests.assertion: 报告缺失时产物上传必须失败。

tests.name: real repository identity handles match, dirty, branch switch, stale, rename and delete
tests.assertion: 真实 Git 仓库中的匹配、脏工作树、分支切换、过期、重命名和删除状态正确。
